'''Niko Beerenwinkel''', Ph.D. (2004), is a German mathematician who is active in the field of [[computational biology]]; he is an associate professor of the [[ETH Zurich]] since April 2013.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Niko Beerenwinkel |url=https://bsse.ethz.ch/cbg/group/people/person-detail.MTQ5NDE3.TGlzdC81MTYsOTQ0ODM3Mzc2.html |access-date=2022-12-23 |website=ETH Zurich |language=en}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* [[Otto Hahn Medal]] - Max Planck Society (2005);
* [[Emmy Noether]] Fellowship - German National Science Foundation.
